**Migration done.** 12 files moved off `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Two calls stay in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit, replaced wholesale on upgrade. That one needs an upstream fix or a wrapper.

`cache.query` calls are a different object. Left alone. No tests in the repo to run.
